text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara crossed the finish line in 
first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Experiencing the feeling of running in the 
lead and cutting through the wind for the 
very first time, she gleefully jumped for 
joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking first place filled Haru Urara with 
overwhelming joy. Ignited with passion, 
she burned with a desire to win first 
place again and again.
